Overtime Calculation
fields.options:
Overtime Calculation

An active, submitted Salary Structure Assignment must exist for the employee before overtime can be calculated.

Formula:
OT Hourly Rate = Base Salary Component ÷ Standard Working Hours Per Month × OT Multiplier

Example:
Base Salary Component = 100,000
Standard Working Hours = 208
OT Multiplier = 1.5

OT Hourly Rate = 100,000 ÷ 208 × 1.5 = 721.15 per hour.

OT Amount = OT Hourly Rate × Approved OT Hours
